visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a small pickup truck with ring wheels on its body line at the left and a kneeling child (large ring head, torso, shin on the floor) pushing it with one arm; reads as a child playing with a toy car. First candidate had the arm running flat into the truck bed; the hand now meets the rear wall.
omissions: The reference's crawling pose is changed to kneeling upright (a crawl needs a diagonal head gap the checker cannot certify and more width than remains beside the truck); the child's second arm is omitted.
